title: Sanghamunu Koolchake – Pr D.Isaac Gnana Raj Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: మనుషుల దూరం చేసేడి కొండెములను నీవు చాటకే
పగతో నింపబడక నీవు దేవుని ప్రేమతో నింపబడు
english: Manushula dooram chesedi kondemulanu neevu chaatake
Pagatho nimpabadaka neevu devuni prematho nimpabadu
translation: Do not destroy the Church, do not stir up strife.
Do not spread slanders that distance people from one another.
You cannot reach the kingdom of God without forgiveness.
Do not be filled with vengeance; rather, be filled with the love of God.
A person without humility will not heed the Word.
They cannot remain united, and they fall to ruin by acting rashly.
The one who loves God endures even loss.
They bear the cross daily and cling to the Church.
intro: Sanghamunu Koolchake is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tune & music composed by Pr D.Isaac Gnana Raj, produced by Joshua Kamal Raj. This song was released on April 30, 2026, through Satyadaivarchana Tv YouTube Channel.
